chunks: And it is not fitting for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allah and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should have [the option of] choice in their affair. And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly gone astray in a clear way.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean for believers to have no choice when Allah and His Messenger decide?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Ayat al-Ikhtiyar) is pivotal for establishing the infallibility and binding authority of the Prophet and the Imams, particularly in matters of divine decree. It underscores that obedience to the Messenger is not merely a choice but a necessity, linking the finality of Allah's command with the practical implementation through His chosen representatives. The verse serves as a foundational proof for the concept of 'Amr al-Mutlaq' (absolute command) in Shia jurisprudence.
